Broader lives. Honest results.

100 original new biographies stay frozen. An additional 24 new biographies address coverage gaps. All 24 older models were reviewed with fixed answers and separately reinterpreted from expanded life histories.

Biography writers saw no questions or engine. Different agents inferred responses from frozen histories and question text. Each answer set was frozen before scoring. This is prompt-level separation, not a filesystem sandbox.

What changed

  • Shared tasks can no longer crowd out a role on the strength of broadly bundled options. Extra evidence must come from narrow options across multiple questions and domains.
  • Career cards say when several jobs share the same tasks. Alternatives remain reachable.
  • Plans separate actual education requirements from an optional subject focus, and exports include detailed requirements.
  • Law budgets cover three law-school years. Nursing, EMT and architecture have explicit paid-study scenarios instead of accidental zero costs.
  • Lifestyle comparisons state when education still needs funding. No aid or borrowing is invented.

The 60 official questions and labels, scoring, student answers, notes and saved work remain unchanged. No questions were added to the student route.

Outliers worth reviewing

  • Sofia · device interests: broad extra options originally suppressed mechanical and electrical engineering in favor of biomedical engineering. The revised rule retains all three as shared-work options.
  • Priya · design and meaning: interpreting appears without a language-specific work preference. This is a shared-task ambiguity, not evidence of language ability.
  • Mateo · sound and stories: the inferred answers endorse editing more strongly than the life narrative does. Both versions stay visible; the answers were not rewritten.
  • Isabel · coding and data: several careers tie. No arbitrary winning plan is assigned.
  • Every original student: all 24 independent dispositions, historical-versus-candidate results and parallel answer differences.

Counts describe these simulations only. They are not error rates or student success rates. Seventy cases informed development; the 30-case holdout was scored only after the candidate was locked. Its remaining ambiguities are retained.

Education corrections

law: Four undergraduate years, three law-school budgets, separately labeled summer living reserve. Published source ↗

nursing: ACC in-district traditional ADN example: $9,724 listed program expenses, plus separate study living and health assumptions; three-year prerequisite/program scenario. Published source ↗

emt: ACC EMT example: $1,911 listed expenses, plus four-month living and health assumptions. No automatic free-course claim. Published source ↗

architecture: Five-year BArch example, using current UT undergraduate range and separate living assumptions; supervised experience and exams remain additional stages. Published source ↗

Reference budgets are current-dollar scenarios before aid, not tuition quotes or assumed debt. Every case shows the route, cost, duration, funding still needed and pay stage.

What this does not establish

  • Fictional response inference is uncertain; all original 100 cases contain substantial low-confidence inferred official answers. Rich histories cannot establish responses to every imagined work activity.
  • Original 100 authors varied family/resources/access, but repeated creative/practical interests, mature reflection and supportive developmental arcs. Additional 24 are new cases addressing gaps; no old histories were repaired.
  • Shared media, meaning and device prompts do not fully distinguish translation, writing/film/animation or biomedical applications. Shared-work labels and conservative prominence prevent one generic task from being presented as proof of a specialty; a separate role-specific preference may still be needed.
  • Original 24 expansions inherit career-suggestive narrative seeds, so parallel interpretations are not an independent blind sample.
  • The locked 30-case holdout was evaluated after development, without answer revisions or post-holdout rule tuning. Additional 24 are a separate gap cohort, not a fresh representative validation sample.
  • Conditional plan previews exercise the first displayed career; they are not observed student decisions or correct-career targets. Real users choose the job after reading its work and training requirements.

Private local test histories and individual results are excluded from this public library.
